pipeline.title: ArriVent’s phase 3 lung cancer trial flops, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 lung cancer study of ArriVent BioPharma’s EGFR inhibitor has missed its primary endpoint, sending the biotech’s stock down 57% in early trading on the Nasdaq.

pipeline.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval for new CardioMEMS HF System that allows heart readings to be seen at home
pipeline.summary: Abbott has been given U.S. clearance for new updates to its CardioMEMS HF System that allow for patient-facing capabilities through its CardioGuide HF App.

pipeline.title: The top biopharma conferences in 2027
pipeline.summary: Medical meetings often feature important clinical trial results, making them barometers of biotech and pharma companies’ research progress. Here’s a list of conferences to watch for in 2027.

pipeline.title: [Podcast] (Season 2) The Progress Profile: Alzheimer’s Research in Focus
pipeline.summary: This podcast explores how leading Alzheimer’s experts are working to bridge the gap between clinical trial design and frontline care.

pipeline.title: Vaxcyte skyrockets on ‘near best-case’ pneumococcal vaccine data
pipeline.summary: The company’s next-generation shot surpassed Wall Street’s expectations by matching the effectiveness of vaccines from Pfizer and Merck on nearly all bacterial strains in the first of three Phase 3 trials.

pipeline.title: Vaxcyte’s stock jumps as pneumococcal vaccine holds its own against Pfizer's, Merck’s shots
pipeline.summary: Vaxcyte has seen its stock jump after the biotech’s 31-valent pneumococcal vaccine candidate went head-to-head with Pfizer’s Prevnar 20 and Merck & Co.’s Capvaxive in a phase 3 contest.

pipeline.title: CSL pays $355M to co-develop Alentis’ phase 2-stage fibrosis drug
pipeline.summary: Australia’s CSL is paying $355 million upfront for the rights to Alentis Therapeutics’ phase 2-stage fibrosis drug.

pipeline.title: Genmab’s latest phase 2 data spur claim ADC is ‘clearly superior’ to AbbVie’s Elahere
pipeline.summary: Genmab has linked an antibody-drug conjugate to a median progression-free survival of 9.5 months, leading TD Cowen analysts to hail the asset as “clearly superior” to AbbVie’s Elahere.

pipeline.title: With FDA approval, Lilly’s BTK drug Jaypirca enters first-line CLL
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly’s Jaypirca, the first noncovalent BTK inhibitor, has won FDA approval for the first-line treatment of chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma, a market now led by BeOne’s Brukinsa.

pipeline.title: Proposed nuclear safety rules threaten to stall Novartis’ Pluvicto expansion
pipeline.summary: Novartis’ flagship radioligand therapy Pluvicto entered a rapid growth phase recently, driven by FDA approvals in earlier-stage prostate cancer and broader uptake in community settings. But a regulatory overhaul proposed by federal nuclear authorities now threatens to derail that

pipeline.title: Taiho scores phase 3 win with oral cancer combo for AML-causing blood disorders
pipeline.summary: The oral combination treatment delivered the same exposure to azacitidine as when the chemo was given subcutaneously—meeting Taiho’s primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Lilly gives deeper glimpse at Foundayo's heart-helping odds in diabetes, obesity phase 3
pipeline.summary: In a new update, Lilly tied Foundayo to a 53% reduction in the risk of cardiovascular death and a 57% lower risk of all-cause mortality compared with insulin glargine in a preplanned analysis of its phase 3 Achieve-4 trial.

pipeline.title: Meet Motivista: Click Therapeutics debuts first-of-its-kind schizophrenia digital therapeutic
pipeline.summary: Click Therapeutics has nabbed FDA approval for its digital therapeutic Motivista, which now becomes the first authorized treatment for negative schizophrenia symptoms.

pipeline.title: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig halts development of lead fusion protein in rare autoimmune disease
pipeline.summary: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig Therapeutics has halted one of the two trials for its sole clinical asset after determining the program wouldn’t be able to advance quickly enough.

pipeline.title: Forbion, a prominent biotech investor, raises $2.6B for a pair of venture funds
pipeline.summary: The fundraise is the firm’s largest to date, providing a lift for a European biotech industry that’s fallen further behind its counterparts in the U.S. and China.

pipeline.title: ArriVent collapses on disappointing lung cancer data
pipeline.summary: More than half of the company’s value was wiped out by findings that appear to erase a chance to battle Johnson & Johnson and others for market share.

pipeline.title: Dual-acting drug from AbbVie, Genmab scores in frontline lymphoma trial
pipeline.summary: The better-than-expected results could make Epkinly the new “undisputed” treatment standard in newly diagnosed DLBCL, according to one analyst.

pipeline.title: ViiV girds data package for Cabenuva in competitive HIV treatment market
pipeline.summary: As competition in both the HIV treatment and prevention fields continues to mount, GSK’s ViiV Healthcare is looking to expand the reach of its long-acting Cabenuva, homing in on the combination treatment’s potential to help people whose infection isn’t adequately kept in check by

pipeline.title: AbbVie, Genmab score first-line DLBCL win for Epkinly, teeing up challenge to Roche's Polivy
pipeline.summary: Epkinly plus R-CHOP cut the risk of progression or death by 51% compared with R-CHOP alone in newly diagnosed DLBCL, setting up a potential first-line challenge to Roche’s Polivy.

pipeline.title: Kairos seizes moment to push prostate cancer prospect into earlier setting
